item.title: Google makes Gemini Tasks free across six international markets
item.description: Google is turning Gemini from a conversational assistant into an execution layer that can make calls, handle bills and complete approved tasks.

item.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion for AI drug discovery
item.description: Alphabet-backed Isomorphic Labs has secured a record-scale Series C to expand AI-native drug design and move more candidates toward patients.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower costs
item.description: OpenAI’s new frontier pair targets professional agents and everyday workflows, combining higher benchmark scores with cheaper inference and tighter safeguards.

item.title: ⚡ 5 quick hits — Morning edition, Nov 18
item.description: · SID AI released SID-2, an agentic search model whose swarm mode reportedly reached 0.720 NDCG through coordinated retrieval agents.（MarkTechPost） · Meshy launched the Z-Axis Awards, backed by $300,000 in prizes, and introduced a million-dollar fund for 3D creators.（X / Meshy AI） · Anthropic added Code Mode to Claude Code, allowing JavaScript to chain tool calls for more efficient multi-step coding workflows.（MarkTechPost） · Tencent open-weighted Hy4 Flash, a 224B-parameter multimodal model with 12B active parameters and a one-million-token context window.（X / Tencent Hunyuan） · Alibaba Qwen announced Qwen4-Max availability on Runware, extending access to the model through a third-party generative media platform.（X / Alibaba Qwen）

item.title: ⚡ 8 quick hits — Evening edition, Nov 17
item.description: · Microsoft introduced MAI Licensed Weights, letting selected enterprises customize Microsoft AI models with proprietary data while keeping deployment inside Azure.（X / Microsoft AI） · Replit Desktop lets Devin Agent work with files in shared local folders, build tools, and turn local data into shareable reports.（X / Replit） · Perplexity launched Orchestrator API preview, automatically routing requests across more than 45 models from multiple providers.（X / Perplexity AI） · Krea launched Video Swap, a workflow for changing characters, products, and backgrounds in existing footage with precise control.（X / Krea AI） · ElevenLabs released Scribe v3 Live Medical, a real-time transcription model reporting 12.8% word error rate on medical benchmarks.（ElevenLabs） · HeyGen introduced Avatar 6, which it said 84% of test viewers failed to distinguish from real people in its avatar evaluation.（X / HeyGen） · Cognition introduced Devin Bots, collaborative software-engineering agents that divide planning, coding, testing, and review across specialized bots.（X / Cognition） · Kling Image 4.0 launched with native 8K generation, long text rendering, and batch image creation for professional visual workflows.（X / Kling AI）
